title: A Tale of Two Cities
author: Charles Dickens
description: 《双城记》是英国批判现实主义文学大师查尔斯·狄更斯于 1859 年创作的历史小说巅峰巨作。故事背景设定在 18 世纪末法国大革命前后的伦敦与巴黎。饱受白塔监狱 18 年折磨的马奈特医生在女儿露西的关爱下恢复理智。然而露西的丈夫查尔斯·达奈在返回巴黎救助老仆时被革命法庭判处死刑。爱慕露西的英国放浪律师西德尼·卡顿出于无私至爱，毅然走进死牢替换达奈，走向断头台。“这是最好的时代，也是最坏的时代”的开篇语名扬千古。

chapters.title: Chapter 1: The Best of Times and the Mail Coach
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 1 章：最好的时代与夜色中的邮政马车

paragraphs.en: It was the best of times, it was the worst of times, it was the age of wisdom, it was the age of foolishness, it was the epoch of belief, it was the epoch of incredulity, it was the season of Light, it was the season of Darkness, it was the spring of hope, it was the winter of despair, we had everything before us, we had nothing before us, we were all going direct to Heaven, we were all going direct the other way—in short, the period was so far like the present period, that some of its noisiest authorities insisted on its being received, for good or for evil, in the superlative degree of comparison only.
paragraphs.zh: 这是最好的时代，这是最坏的时代；这是智慧的时代，这是愚蠢的时代；这是信仰的时期，这是怀疑的时期；这是光明的季节，这是黑暗的季节；这是希望的春天，这是绝望的冬天；我们面前拥有一切，我们面前一无所有；我们都在直奔天堂，我们都在直奔相反的方向——简而言之，那个时期与现在的时期是如此相似，以至于它的一些最高权威坚持认为，无论是好是坏，都只能用最高级的程度来进行评估与接受。

paragraphs.en: It was the Dover road that lay, on a Friday night late in November, before the Dover mail. Heavy fog steamed up from the hollows, and the horses stumbled through the deep mud of Shooters Hill. A horseman rode up, his face wrapped in a heavy scarf, calling out for Mr. Jarvis Lorry, a passenger from Tellson's Bank in London.
paragraphs.zh: 在十一月下旬一个星期五的深夜，多佛邮政马车正行驶在多佛大道上。浓雾从山谷中蒸腾而起，马匹在射手山的深泥中艰难蹒跚。一名骑手骑马赶来，脸裹在厚厚的围巾里，高喊要找来自伦敦泰尔森银行的乘客贾维斯·洛里先生。

paragraphs.en: The messenger handed Mr. Lorry a slip of paper with the message: 'Wait at Dover for Mam'selle.' Mr. Lorry wrote back three words shrouded in mystery: 'Recalled to Life.'
paragraphs.zh: 信使递给洛里先生一张纸条，上面写着：“在多佛等候小姐。”洛里先生回写了充满神秘色彩的三个字：“死而复生。”

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Recalled to Life - The Wine-Shop
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 2 章：重获新生与圣安东尼区酒馆

paragraphs.en: A large cask of wine had been dropped and broken in the street of Saint Antoine in Paris. The red wine ran down the rough cobblestones, and the starving people scrambled on their knees to drink the spilled wine. A tall joker dipped his finger in the lees and wrote upon a wall: BLOOD.
paragraphs.zh: 在巴黎的圣安东尼街，一大桶葡萄酒掉落并破碎了。红酒沿着粗糙的鹅卵石路流淌，饥饿的人们跪着爬行去喝洒出的葡萄酒。一个高个子的戏谑者把手指浸在酒渣里，在墙上写下了单字：血。

paragraphs.en: Inside the wine-shop sat Monsieur Defarge and his wife Madame Defarge, who spent all day silently knitting a secret register of hated aristocrats condemned to die when the revolution came. Defarge led Mr. Lorry and young Lucie Manette up to a dark garret where Dr. Alexandre Manette sat on a stool frantically making shoes.
paragraphs.zh: 在酒馆内部坐着德法热先生和他的妻子德法热太太，她整天默默编织着一份受人憎恨贵族的秘密死亡注册表。德法热带着洛里先生和年轻的露西·马奈特走上一间黑暗的阁楼，亚历山大·马奈特医生正坐在凳子上发疯似地做鞋。

paragraphs.en: Imprisoned in the Bastille for eighteen years without trial, Dr. Manette remembered his name only as '105 North Tower.' But as Lucie wrapped her arms around him, her golden hair brought back his memory, and Dr. Manette was softly recalled to life.
paragraphs.zh: 在巴士底狱未经审判被关押了十八年，马奈特医生只记得自己的名字是“北塔 105 号”。但当露西用手臂环绕住他时，她金色的头发带回了他的记忆，马奈特医生静静地被召回了生命。

chapters.title: Chapter 3: The Trial at the Old Bailey
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 3 章：老贝利法庭的惊险审判

paragraphs.en: Five years later, in the Old Bailey courtroom of London, a young French emigré named Charles Darnay stood trial for high treason, accused of spying. The prosecution case seemed airtight, backed by corrupt witnesses.
paragraphs.zh: 五年后，在伦敦的老贝利法庭上，一位名叫查尔斯·达奈的年轻法国移民因高瞻叛国罪受审，被指控从事间谍活动。控方案情似乎严丝合缝，得到了腐败证人的支持。

paragraphs.en: Suddenly, Sydney Carton, a brilliant but careless lawyer, pointed out that he himself bore an astonishing physical resemblance to Darnay! This uncanny likeness shattered the key witness's credibility, and Darnay was acquitted.
paragraphs.zh: 突然，西德尼·卡顿（一位卓越而随意的律师）指出他自己与达奈在长相上有着惊人的相似！这种不可思议的相似性粉碎了关键证人的可信度，达奈被宣告无罪。

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Sydney Carton’s Secret Promise
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 4 章：西德尼·卡顿的秘密承诺

paragraphs.en: Sydney Carton squandered his immense intellect in heavy drinking and melancholy. In Darnay, Carton saw everything he himself might have been if he had not ruined his life. Though he harbored a deep love for Lucie Manette, Carton promised her with tears: 'For you, and for any dear to you, I would embrace any sacrifice!'
paragraphs.zh: 西德尼·卡顿在沉溺酗酒与忧郁中挥霍着巨大的智慧。在达奈身上，卡顿看到了如果自己没有毁掉生活本可能成为的一切。尽管他向露西·马奈特怀着深沉的爱，卡顿含泪向她承诺：“为了你，以及任何你亲爱的人，我愿意拥抱任何牺牲！”

chapters.title: Chapter 5: The Reign of Terror in Paris
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 5 章：巴黎的恐怖统治与绝境救援

paragraphs.en: The French Revolution erupted in 1789. The masses stormed the Bastille, and the Reign of Terror began. Charles Darnay, who had renounced his noble inheritance as the Marquis St. Evrémonde, returned secretly to Paris to save his old servant Gabelle, but was arrested and thrown into La Force prison.
paragraphs.zh: 1789 年法国大革命爆发。群众攻陷了巴士底狱，恐怖统治开始了。已经放弃了作为圣埃弗雷蒙德侯爵贵族继承权的查尔斯·达奈，秘密回到巴黎拯救他的老仆人加贝尔，但被逮捕并扔进了拉福尔斯监狱。

chapters.title: Chapter 6: The Parchment in the Bastille Cell
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 6 章：巴士底狱羊皮纸的声讨

paragraphs.en: Though Dr. Manette saved Darnay at his first trial, Madame Defarge produced a hidden parchment written by Dr. Manette during his Bastille imprisonment, denouncing the St. Evrémonde family for atrocious crimes. The Revolutionary Tribunal condemned Darnay to die on the Guillotine within twenty-four hours.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然马奈特医生在第一次审判中救了达奈，但德法热太太出示了一份马奈特医生在服刑期间写的隐藏羊皮纸，声讨圣埃弗雷蒙德家族残暴的罪行。革命法庭判处查尔斯·达奈在二十四小时内下断头台。

chapters.title: Chapter 7: The Prisoner in La Force
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 7 章：拉福尔斯监狱的死牢顶替

paragraphs.en: Sydney Carton arrived in Paris with quiet resolve. Overhearing Madame Defarge plotting to execute Lucie next, Carton arranged for Mr. Lorry to take Lucie and her family back to England. Carton then entered Darnay's cell, drugged Darnay into unconsciousness, swapped clothes with him, and had a friend carry Darnay out to the waiting carriage to flee to safety.
paragraphs.zh: 西德尼·卡顿怀着平静的决心来到了巴黎。在无意中听到德法热太太谋划接下来处决露西时，卡顿安排洛里先生带着露西和她的家人逃回英国。接着卡顿进入达奈的牢房，用药物把达奈迷晕过去，与他互换了衣服，并让一个朋友把达奈抬出去送到等待的马车上逃向安全地带。

chapters.title: Chapter 8: The Ultimate Sacrifice at the Guillotine
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 8 章：断头台下的至爱与永恒救赎（终极结局）

paragraphs.en: In the tumbril bound for the Guillotine, Sydney Carton held the hand of a poor young seamstress, comforting her with serene dignity as they mounted the scaffold. As the blade fell, Carton's soul looked far into the future, foreseeing a peaceful Paris and Lucie's children honoring his memory through generations. His heart spoke those immortal words: 'It is a far, far better thing that I do, than I have ever done; it is a far, far better rest that I go to than I have ever known.'
paragraphs.zh: 在前往断头台的囚车上，西德尼·卡顿紧握着一位可怜年轻女裁缝的手，当他们登上断头台时以平静的尊严安慰着她。当刀刃落下时，卡顿的灵魂看向了遥远的未来，预见到一座和平的巴黎以及露西的后代世世代代缅怀他的纪念。他的心吐露了那些永恒的名言：“我所做的，是一件远比我做过的所有事情都美好得多的事；我所前往的，是一处远比我所知道的所有休息都美好得多的安息。”
